title: Accessible navigation and interaction patterns
use_when: Compare keyboard and focus behavior for a specific interface pattern.
limits: Interaction guidance, not a visual style or a claim that a particular implementation passes accessibility review.

title: Reduced motion preferences
use_when: Plan alternatives to large movement, parallax and decorative transitions.
limits: A media query alone does not establish that every animation or embedded widget respects the preference.

title: EVZ approved voice demo and dotted waveform
use_when: Review an existing studio example with a documented design decision and repeatable verification.
limits: Reference only; its style is not a default for other clients. Source and verification: docs/voice-demo-ui/README.md.
